mau.math: The base is $70 for 1,000 users with two active days. Other usage, and the exact bill from users alone, are unknown.
Assumes each of the 10,000 users is active on 2 days of a 30-day month. $70 base, plus $0.14 per average daily active user, minus a $21 credit. That totals $142.33 a month.
Assumes each of the 50,000 users is active on 2 days of a 30-day month. $70 base, plus $0.14 per average daily active user, minus a $21 credit. That totals $515.67 a month.
Assumes each of the 100,000 users is active on 2 days of a 30-day month. $70 base, plus $0.14 per average daily active user, minus a $21 credit. That totals $982.33 a month.
